codeExtra: 2/4/6/8 digits; digit count is the level (major/middle/minor/detail)
name: Service Name
parentIdPlaceholder: Select the parent (exactly one level up)
requiredParentId: Please select the parent service type
deleteConfirmDesc: Are you sure to delete this {{moduleName}}?
standardWorkHoursExtra: Standard man-hours per job, for dispatch load and performance accounting
guidancePlaceholder: SOP and safety notes (e.g. lockout-tagout, two-person work, hot-work permit, cold chain 2-8°C)
commonPhrasesPlaceholder: Press Enter or comma to add, e.g. the light is out / STAT specimen
commonPhrasesExtra: Quick phrases for requesters; also corpus for phrase-to-type matching
standardToolsPlaceholder: Press Enter or comma to add, e.g. test pen / wheelchair
sparePartsPlaceholder: Press Enter or comma to add, e.g. LED tube
defaultPriorityExtra: Weights dispatch ordering and SLA escalation; details may override (urgent delivery, entrapment)
acceptance.modesExtra: Repair = completion acceptance, transport = handover sign-off; combinable (e.g. scan + sign)
acceptance.itemsExtra: Checked item by item on the completion/delivery page; toggle off for optional hints
acceptance.addItemPlaceholder: Enter item name, e.g. quantity verified
temperatureRequirementExtra: Cold chain for specimens/drugs/blood, warm keeping for meal delivery
requiresApprovalExtra: Controlled services (move-in/out escort, hot work, resource requests) need approval before dispatch
cargoTypesPlaceholder: Press Enter or comma to add, e.g. blood specimen
cargoTypesExtra: Cargo scope of this type; anything beyond should be requested under another type
responseTimeLimitTransportExtra: Call accepted → arrive at pickup point
completionTimeLimitTransportExtra: Picked up → delivered and signed at destination
route.name: Route Name
route.viaPointsPlaceholder: Press Enter or comma to add (in order)
route.estDurationExtra: Baseline for dispatch ETA and timeout checks
route.roundTripExtra: Return to origin along the same route (e.g. meal cart return, pickup rounds)
route.departureTimesExtra: Depart daily at these times; remove all for on-demand dispatch
route.empty: No transport routes under this category
plan.name: Plan Name
plan.requiredTimes: Add at least one execution time
plan.timesExtra: Each execution day runs once per time point; multiple times a day = multiple points
plan.requiredWeekdays: Weekly plan requires at least one weekday
plan.requiredMonthDays: Monthly/yearly plan requires at least one day of month
plan.monthDaysExtra: -1 means the last day of the month
plan.clampToMonthEndExtra: When on, day numbers beyond the month clamp to its last day (Feb 31 runs on Feb 28/29); when off, skipped that month
plan.requiredMonths: Yearly plan requires at least one month
plan.excludedDatesExtra: No tasks generated on these dates (e.g. public holidays)
plan.rangeExtra: Leave empty for always effective; end date inclusive
plan.itemsExtra: Derived from standard items; toggle or remove per plan (disabled items kept but not executed)
plan.importFromStandard: Pick from standard items or type freely
plan.empty: No periodic plans under this category

executionPostExtra: Dispatch target post; keep names consistent with crew posts

standardItemsExtra: Template source for plan checklists; plans may add/remove or toggle items
plan.createAfterSaveHint: Trigger mode "Scheduled" selected: after saving the type, configure periodic plans in the edit tab
